figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Difference of physiological functions between B. bassiana WT and ΔbasA mutant. (A) SEM analysis of conidia shows that B. bassiana WT
has characteristic rodlet bundles on the cell wall; however, the ΔbasA mutant has a bald phenotype. (B) TEM analysis of conidia shows that the cell
envelope of the ΔbasA mutant exhibits a fluffy appearance. The cell wall is marked by black arrows. For insecticidal bioassays, G. mellonella larvae
were treated via topical inoculation (C) or intrahemocoel injection (D) with conidia from B. bassiana WT or ΔbasA mutant. The data are
presented as mean ± SD of three independent experiments (33 subjects per treatment). Tween-80 solution was used as the control.
